answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 5549 Country: India Title: Is tafseer of tafheemul quran of jamat e islami hind is fully right for study and amal if it is not right what is reasion behind this? Question: Is tafseer of tafheemul quran of jamat e islami hind is fully right for study and amal if it is not right what is reasion behind this? Answer ID: 5549 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 629/581=D) No. there are many unauthentic things in the above-mentioned Tafseer. According to Ulama, the tafseer is not among reliable ones. Its study may lead one to academic, practical and ideological deviation. One should avoid studying it in order to protect oneself from going astray from the right path. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
